user.title: Choose a Tapo IR hub
user.description: Reuse a loaded Home Assistant TP-Link hub session (recommended), or choose direct credentials. Shared mode stores no credentials and avoids competing KLAP sessions.

direct.title: Connect directly to a Tapo IR hub
direct.description: Enter the hub IP and case-sensitive Tapo account credentials. Direct mode is retained for installations where the core TP-Link integration does not expose the hub.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate your Tapo IR hub
reauth_confirm.description: Credentials for the hub at {host} were rejected.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure your Tapo IR hub
reconfigure.description: Choose the same shared hub again, or update and validate direct connection details.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the hub address, availability, and onboarding state.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid Tapo account credentials. The username is case-sensitive.
error.shared_hub_unavailable: The selected core TP-Link hub is no longer loaded.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Tapo IR hub is already configured.
abort.reauth_not_required: Shared-session hubs do not store credentials.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Tapo IR hub was reconfigured successfully.
abort.wrong_hub: The selected connection belongs to a different hub.

init.title: Tapo IR hub options
init.description: Set the refresh interval and optional JSON device-name overrides.

error.invalid_overrides: Name overrides must be a JSON object mapping device IDs to names.

shared_parent_unavailable.title: TP-Link hub unavailable
shared_parent_unavailable.description: Tapo IR Hub cannot refresh {hub} because its owning TP-Link integration entry is unavailable. Check the hub's power and network connection, then reload the TP-Link entry. Tapo IR entities will recover automatically when the parent hub becomes available.
